invariants.rationale: className is used as a key in projectClassInfo.get(className), so null would cause errors.
classProperties is passed to methods and used as a target for put(), so it cannot be null.
classElement is used for method calls like classElement.get(...), so it cannot be null.
The method potentially populates classProperties, so after execution it is likely to have at least one key.
When a 'class' property is processed, nestedClassProperties has 'type' key added, tying classProperties type information to classElement objectness.
